judge.evidence:
No rule (a) failure. The PERSON gave only card facts: "It is for myself. My date of birth is 20/06/1959." (card DOB 20/06/1959) and "my number is 9807009700. this is my phone." (card number 9807009700). The PERSON never stated a name, village, bank account, or document that the card does not give. The assistant's own values (application number, block, submission date) were not the PERSON's facts.

No rule (b) failure. The required behaviours were followed: "I want to apply for pension. Old age pension please." (ask for old age pension); "no no, make a new one, the old one maybe lost." (response when told of an existing application); "no no, I dont want to withdraw. I just want my pension." (refusal to withdraw). The card's "say thank you" behaviour is conditional on the PERSON understanding that the old application is pending. The transcript never shows that understanding: after the status message the PERSON kept asking for a new application, and the transcript ends while the PERSON is still trying to use the OTP page. So the thank-you was not yet triggered and was not skipped.
